name: Data-scape
desc: A Ryoji-Ikeda / Alva-Noto data console: crisp monochrome barcode strips, quantized spectral bars, oscilloscope waveforms and ticking hex columns stacked into registers and raked by a scanning cursor, the whole field reshuffling and brightening with the musical arc; renders as white-on-black data, amber CRT, cyan blueprint schematic, RGB-datamosh glitch, or green phosphor terminal.

density.doc: register-channel count + bar/glyph packing (structural; max = dense multi-channel console)

energy.doc: lit-bar fraction + mark brightness + waveform/spectrum amplitude

hue.doc: accent color (drives the mono style's single accent; other styles carry fixed accents)

style.doc: render philosophy: white-on-black Ikeda data / amber CRT phosphor / cyan blueprint schematic (hollow outline bars) / RGB-datamosh channel-split glitch / green phosphor terminal

seed.doc: layout + barcode/spectrum/ticker pattern seed (inline hash, deterministic)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100=opaque bg; lower = translucent data overlay)

act.doc: dramaturgy: stream (balanced) / spectrum (bars+wave forward, barcode recedes) / glitch (RGB tearing scales with musical intensity)
